name: 더 클라우드 블러 크림 블러셔
scope: Standalone product-detail proposal using the approved Cheek V12/Lip Liner visual family. Existing product pages and production storefront unchanged.
direction: Blush introduction, original product photography, real cheek application, six two-column shade comparisons, cream-to-powder footage, concise application guide, vegan formula and ingredient support, full six-product closing.

assets.photographs: Original brand product photos, second-round named cheek swatches and original texture swatches from the Cloud Cream Blush asset folder.
assets.videos: Original Cloud Blush cheek, hand-edge blending and texture footage; full duration with proportional web sizing and silent H.264 encoding.
assets.edits: Web resize/compression and CSS framing only. No generated images, skin retouch or colour filters. No unverified colour name assigned to footage.

claims.product_info: Current official product specifications and all six ingredient lists preserved in an expandable disclosure, fetched 2026-10-15.
claims.formula: Four named oils verified in all six official ingredient lists. Vegan copy follows original brand material; no certification badge or new certification claim.
claims.excluded: Old planning examples for 12-hour wear, controlled before/after results, awards, fabricated reviews and unsupported clinical numbers.

verification: 320, 390, 600, 860 and 1440px: six shade cards, no horizontal overflow, images loaded, no JS errors, shade navigation and product-info disclosure checked. Mobile section renders visually reviewed.
approval: Technical checks are not visual acceptance. Await owner review.
